subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Which public contract should OpenClaw expose, if any, for disabling built-in skill source roots such as `agents-skills-personal`?
rationale: The source-level problem is real, but every useful repair adds or changes public `skills.load` configuration and built-in source semantics, which repository policy treats as a maintainer product/API decision.

options.title: Add typed source disables
options.body: Expose a narrow enum-like `skills.load.disabledSources` list, default to current behavior, and skip disabled sources before both discovery and watcher registration.

options.title: Add personal-source toggle
options.body: Expose a smaller boolean for only `~/.agents/skills`, reducing immediate API surface but leaving project-agent and future source opt-outs unresolved.

options.title: Keep current loading model
options.body: Decline new config surface and document per-agent allowlists, prompt limits, and per-skill disables as the supported controls.

recommendation.title: Add typed source disables
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow enum-like `skills.load.disabledSources` list, default to current behavior, and skip disabled sources before both discovery and watcher registration.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history on the watcher/config/docs side of the skills surface and is the best available owner for the API-shape decision.
